events.title: alpha.5 Proofs wait for the host
events.detail: A full proof waits for its repository's proof slot and the host's load before any gate runs. Declared native outputs take tool-neutral formats, so a repository's own tests can evidence languages ETHOS does not check itself.

events.title: alpha.6 Line endings, license grants
events.detail: The paradigm judges each tracked file's line endings by its effective Git attributes. A tracked license grant is checked against pinned SPDX templates, linked from README.md and matched against package metadata.

events.title: alpha.8 The host store stops growing
events.detail: Each repository records itself in the installations it selects, and hook install retires those that no consumer or process uses. ethos hook retire-supply previews installations pinned before that. v0.2.0-alpha.10 first published these changes.

events.title: alpha.18 One proof per Change
events.detail: The archived head is proved once, and landing requires that proof. If it fails, archive-change --compensate returns the archive to its exact pre-archive head. ethos prove drops --execution-root.

events.title: alpha.19 One set of obligations
events.detail: The packaged system/gates.toml holds only the obligations every repository runs. ETHOS judges its own tree by them and declares its own gates apart, so obligations no longer depend on a registry path or history.

events.title: alpha.22 A per-file ceiling of 500
events.detail: Each tracked Python file may hold 500 effective lines, and each authored Markdown document 500 nonblank lines. A repository may lower its ceiling, or raise it to 1000 with a stated reason.

events.title: alpha.26 Shared formatter settings
events.detail: A repository needs no Prettier, Taplo or Ruff carrier of its own, because the formatters run on the settings ETHOS ships. Every governed repository keeps CONTRIBUTING.md beside AGENTS.md and README.md.

events.title: alpha.27 Every wait is declared
events.detail: The paradigm declares each wait's default, unit and bound, and a repository may set its own in .ethos/rules.toml. Every gate now runs within a deadline, its own or the repository's.

events.title: alpha.29 Releases rehearse adoption
events.detail: Each release run attests its archives and wheels with GitHub artifact attestations. It qualifies the prerelease on macOS and Linux, from a cold install through a full proof, upgrade, rollback and uninstall.

events.title: beta.2 First beta, one host queue
events.detail: ethos host run admits heavy local commands through one queue per host, and a full proof takes the same host slot. Load admission now waits for two consecutive 1-minute samples within the limit.

events.title: beta.3 Timeouts report unknown
events.detail: A timed-out gate, an absent command and a prerequisite of unknown state now report unknown instead of block. A lane's holder reads and renews its Lease through native commands.

events.title: beta.6 Result schema 3
events.detail: A schema-2 payload is refused. Every JSON result fits 16 KiB, or 32 KiB for plan, and carries its next step as data. The publication declaration no longer takes forge_repository in a peer.

events.title: beta.7 One operation catalog
events.detail: Every command selects one declared operation from the catalog, so the CLI, the SDK and the MCP tools refuse the same requests alike. The npm launcher is retired; run the installed ethos.

events.title: beta.8 Community health files
events.detail: A governed repository may keep at its root, beside CONTRIBUTING.md, the Markdown community health files GitHub reads there: ACCESSIBILITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md and SUPPORT.md.
